text:
maya: Heads up — finance flagged a ~$9.2k spike yesterday tied to storage egress. Looks like the log-replay pipeline moved ~18TB to us-west-2 overnight. 

liam: Wait, replay pipeline == archive replay job? which job ID? :eyes:

maya: yes, archive-replay-v2 (k8s cronjob). Pod logs show it started at 02:11 UTC and hit a target bucket in us-west-2. We normally archive to us-east-1.

ops-bot: billing-bot reports: Project:redwood-logging — Inter-region egress: 18.4 TB, Estimated cost: $9,200 — 2025-11-16 02:00-06:00 UTC

sophia: I ran a quick billing query, looks like the transfer was between gs://redwood-logs-eu -> s3://redwood-archive-uswest. Full query snippet I used:
```
SELECT sku.description, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE service.description CONTAINS "Network" AND usage_start_time >= "2025-11-16"
GROUP BY sku.description
```
liam: Do we have an automated cross-cloud sync? That feels off.

noah: There is an infra job that replays raw logs to the long-term archive for QA. It should respect REGION_OVERRIDE env but looks like our CI bumped it to us-west-2 by mistake in the deploy from last Thursday.

maya: Confirmed: commit 1f4c3d9 in infra-config changed REGION_OVERRIDE from eu-west-1 to us-west-2 in the cronchart values. Probably a human error during the chart bump.

ralph: Oof. So two things: (1) mitigate current cost (stop replay), (2) prevent recurrence (guardrails).

sophia: Mitigation: I patched the cronjob to point to a same-region staging bucket and paused the replay. Command I used: `kubectl patch cronjob archive-replay-v2 -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` — paused at 02:35 UTC.

liam: Nice. For immediate cost recovery we should request a billing adjustment and mark this as human-error. I'll open a case with the cloud provider and finance.

maya: Action list: @sophia run full delta for the 24h window and add export of object list; @liam open billing case; @noah revert the chart commit and add CI check; @ralph draft postmortem.

noah: For guardrails: propose adding a pre-deploy lint that ensures REGION_OVERRIDE is within allowed list and a policy to block cross-region replication by default. I can prototype a helm hook.

sophia: Also exporting object inventory to confirm file sizes. Example aws CLI to list target bucket sizes (dry run):
```
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-archive-uswest --query "Contents[].{Key:Key,Size:Size}"
```

billing-bot: ticket#BILL-4457 created with provider support: "Inter-region egress dispute" — case opened by liam at 2025-11-16T03:10:25Z

liam: Putting this on the morning oncall agenda. We should also add a metric to alert on cross-region egress > 1TB/hour.

maya: Agreed. I'll add an alert and a short note to the infra-runbook about verifying REGION_OVERRIDE after upgrades.

ralph: I'll start a one-paragraph incident blurb for finance and legal to sign off on billing outreach.

noah: Reverting chart now, will push 1f4c3d9->revert and create a PR with CI lint. ETA 30m.

sophia: Uploaded the object list CSV to gs://redwood-internal/incident-1815123456/objects.csv and the cost delta CSV to gs://redwood-internal/incident-1815123456/costs.csv

maya: Thanks all. We'll regroup in #eng-oncall 09:30 PT to finalize postmortem and billing next steps. :thumbsup:
